JUDICIAL WATCH PURSUES CIVIL RIGHTS LAWSUIT AGAINST REPARATIONS
POLICY

We’re not backing away from our effort to stop an unconstitutional
city program.

We asked a court to reject
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70272&L=33473&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2ZsaW5uLXYtZXZhbnN0b24tb3Bwby10by1kaXNtaXNzLTA0MjY5Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=86417364e726992d0c8c291158ba68071a8a0fb90731282fc01d4c7ad6186088]
a motion by the City of Evanston, IL, to dismiss our class action
lawsuit on behalf of six individuals over the city’s use of race as
an eligibility requirement for a reparations program.

This program makes $25,000 direct cash payments to black residents and
descendants of black residents who lived in Evanston between the years
1919 and 1969.

Judicial Watch filed the lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70272&L=32489&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcmVwYXJhdGlvbnMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=89544cd8218cb5f8cde2c6d0ede0340043593a1a219f5c54a84c7f4461165ad0]
in the United States

[WEEKLY UPDATE] [] JUDICIAL WATCH PURSUES CIVIL RIGHTS LAWSUIT AGAINST REPARATIONS POLICY We’re not backing away from our effort to stop an unconstitutional city program. We asked a court to reject [] a motion by the City of Evanston, IL, to dismiss our class action lawsuit on behalf of six individuals over the city’s use of race as an eligibility requirement for a reparations program. This program makes $25,000 direct cash payments to black residents and descendants of black residents who lived in Evanston between the years 1919 and 1969. Judicial Watch filed the lawsuit [] in the United States District Court for the Northern District of Illinois, Eastern Division (Flinn et al. v Evanston [] (No. 1:24-cv-04269)). We allege in the complaint that the program violates the Equal Protection Clause of the Fourteenth Amendment to the U.S. Constitution. In response to the city’s motion to dismiss, Judicial Watch argues [] that the case should continue to go forward because: Plaintiffs have alleged all facts necessary to state a timely claim that, but for their race, they are eligible to participate in the program and receive $25,000 direct cash payments. The program’s eligibility requirements are simple, straightforward, and easy to satisfy, and Plaintiffs have alleged that they were and are “ready and able” to satisfy them at all relevant times. They need not allege anything more to invoke this Court’s jurisdiction. [T]he program’s use of a race-based eligibility requirement is presumptively unconstitutional, and remedying societal discrimination is not a compelling government interest. Nor has remedying discrimination from as many as 105 years ago or remedying intergenerational discrimination ever been recognized as a compelling government interest. Among the program’s other fatal flaws is that it uses race as a proxy for discrimination without requiring proof of discrimination. Evanston’s reparations scheme rejects a colorblind Constitution and unconstitutionally discriminates against anyone who does not identify as Black or African American. The court should allow our civil rights lawsuit to move forward. Our lawsuits challenging unconstitutional discrimination are extensive. On January 29, 2024, we filed a lawsuit [] on behalf of San Francisco taxpayers over a city program that discriminates in favor of biological black and Latino men who identify as women in the distribution of tax money. The lawsuit was filed after we earlier forced the release of records from the City of San Francisco showing the city prioritized tax money for black and Latino transgenders (biological men) in the Guaranteed Income for Trans People program. In December 2023, the Minnesota Court of Appeals reversed [] the trial court’s ruling and allowed our historic lawsuit filed on behalf of a Minneapolis taxpayer over a teachers’ contract that provides discriminatory job protections to certain racial minorities to proceed. The City of Asheville, NC, in January 2022 settled [] our federal civil rights lawsuit after agreeing to remove all racially discriminatory provisions in a city-funded scholarship program. Additionally, the city also agreed to remove racially discriminatory eligibility provisions in a related program that provides grants to educators. In May 2022, we won a court battle [] against California’s gender quota law for corporate boards. The verdict came after a 28-day trial. The verdict followed a similar ruling [] in Judicial Watch’s favor in April finding California’s race, ethnicity and LGBT quotas or corporate boards unconstitutional. The rule of law and the equal protection provisions of our state and federal constitutions are under dramatic attack. | | Peter, As a Representative of the American People, it is my duty to ensure your will is done in Washington. _**That includes ensuring that American elections are determined by votes at a ballot box and not an assassin's bullet.**_
---
| | [ ](https://links.lawler4congress.com/els/v2/9-R~HV-DZGJX/dkJUUWtCTlVEd1dmajZLazBUU1lGNkpYeXExRDRmTXRZTC84dDVLY0dQSDdqYlJCY3dsdk9mWmQ3VWRaWEgvWWs2UFAvZElDcGtHZUlpaUpNYzJrQ0owRm94NEwvMHZTQ0plaTNwb1lNZVE9S0/)

body:

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z4663e2l4rb9dac1eok91dptdf8hrk9pqd5hik0g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cji64o72c5h2bs) [NO](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zc3d1fsu6ds3qb5utj3c9r2ip4lubo610pl8t20g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cji64o72c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zjggdesk076qla60ir4v4u5spe76ntq0fi0sv8qg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cji64o72c5h2bs)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: The Babylon Bee
subject: Big Tech vs. the Babylon Bee, Round 1,267,310
body:
When Elon Musk bought Twitter, he sent me a DM that said, “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”

| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zvvdkhoph131ad1bvir4gcvocden4lnqq3bfslog_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cji64o71cdh2bs)
---
|
---
Friend, When Elon Musk bought Twitter, he sent me a DM that said, "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2znq67gfkbt7vuh2h94sogst7m9ar9c3pdj3iblco_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cji64o71cdh2bs)
---
We've been trying to write a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But, in all seriousness - free speech is no joke (not even a multibillion dollar one). The Bee would know - not only did Twitter deplatform us, but other woke Big Tech firms have tried to silence our voice as well.
---
* **Facebook** has deleted our posts and deactivated our account on several occasions.
* **Front** , our internal email service at the time, terminated our account and left us unable to communicate with each other and wider world.
* And, in a particularly ironic move, **Vimeo** permanently suspended the David Horowitz Freedom Center's account because they posted a talk **I gave on censorship. **

---
**It 's clear woke, left-wing tech elitists can't abide by satire that dares mock their progressive orthodoxy**. We're not the only attempted victims of their censorship regime, either. They've gone after our First Amendment ally Musk, too - Disney, Apple, IBM, and Sony are just some of the companies who have pulled their advertising from X to protest the fact that it platforms the Bee and others accused of "wrongthink." All this amounts to a sustained, coordinated attack on free thought and expression. These pillars are central to our mission of speaking truth through humor. **No matter how much pressure they exert, the Bee will never back down. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us**. To people with integrity, like Musk, principles are worth more than money. **But we won 't give them what they want. **We won't stop telling jokes. More importantly, we won't stop telling the _truth_.
---
[ Join The Fight - Subscribe to The Babylon Bee ](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zg3aj88d4cplhk2ag7tn6b3ur8jcke1qilv5he98_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cji64o71cdh2bs)
---
Sure, you may be thinking, a billionaire like Musk can afford to take the hit when radical Leftists try to force X into conformity and submission. That's what we thought, too, but we noticed something in the midst of the censorship campaigns waged against us - we had a superpower progressives couldn't see. And that's our subscribers. **The Bee could not have taken the stand it did against Twitter if we did not have the support of each and every subscriber**. These are people who appreciate humor, yes, but also believe in free speech. Who appreciate debate, dialogue, and discovering new ideas. **[If that sounds like you, I hope you'll consider subscribing to the Babylon Bee. We'd love to have you in the fight for freedom of expression.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zvq4bhhfkk2h453rnu8v1ltg7ju0bjdhf73ij5b0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cji64o71cdh2bs)**
---
[ Yes, I'll Stand With The Babylon Bee](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zg1jrmpordefnp67oqtjn243kh4u2hh5vvm0q7to_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cji64o71cdh2bs)
---
They can hurt us, smear us, reduce our reach; but they can never silence us with free speech supporters like you in our corner. **[Join the fray with us by becoming a Babylon Bee premium subscriber today.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zl05ou9k9v84pqtfnqcv08vtfnj03bgieqcve3s0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cji64o71cdh2bs)** Thanks for considering standing with us. We'll stand with you, too.
---
Seth Dillon

* **Showcase Presidential Pride** : The display case is adorned with a raised golden medallion, inspired by the American presidential seal, making it a stunning centerpiece for any home or office.

subject: Can you think of a $44 billion joke?
body:
We’ve been trying to write a joke worth $44 billion ever since.

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z0nnl9k7o4rt99puegf3handednbo1u814f3v70o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cji66ob2c9h2bs)

|
---
Friend, When Elon Musk bought Twitter, he sent me a DM that said, "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z1gmr3t9h5ptv66tl3toupccn2vrj11hmon6i2mg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cji66ob2c9h2bs)
---
We've been trying to write a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But, in all seriousness - free speech is no joke (not even a multibillion dollar one). The Bee would know - not only did Twitter deplatform us, but other woke Big Tech firms have tried to silence our voice as well.
---
* **Facebook** has deleted our posts and deactivated our account on several occasions.
* **Front** , our internal email service at the time, terminated our account and left us unable to communicate with each other and wider world.
* And, in a particularly ironic move, **Vimeo** permanently suspended the David Horowitz Freedom Center's account because they posted a talk **I gave on censorship. **

---
**It 's clear woke, left-wing tech elitists can't abide by satire that dares mock their progressive orthodoxy**. We're not the only attempted victims of their censorship regime, either. They've gone after our First Amendment ally Musk, too - Disney, Apple, IBM, and Sony are just some of the companies who have pulled their advertising from X to protest the fact that it platforms the Bee and others accused of "wrongthink." All this amounts to a sustained, coordinated attack on free thought and expression. These pillars are central to our mission of speaking truth through humor. **No matter how much pressure they exert, the Bee will never back down. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us**. To people with integrity, like Musk, principles are worth more than money. **But we won 't give them what they want. **We won't stop telling jokes. More importantly, we won't stop telling the _truth_.
---
[ Join The Fight - Subscribe to The Babylon Bee ](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zgja2eeh73mbo7drg4rvtpra3u7qn819qto44dto_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cji66ob2c9h2bs)
---
Sure, you may be thinking, a billionaire like Musk can afford to take the hit when radical Leftists try to force X into conformity and submission. That's what we thought, too, but we noticed something in the midst of the censorship campaigns waged against us - we had a superpower progressives couldn't see. And that's our subscribers. **The Bee could not have taken the stand it did against Twitter if we did not have the support of each and every subscriber**. These are people who appreciate humor, yes, but also believe in free speech. Who appreciate debate, dialogue, and discovering new ideas. **[If that sounds like you, I hope you'll consider subscribing to the Babylon Bee. We'd love to have you in the fight for freedom of expression.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z87uubdtc8akvt77g0v8f94t9md4f1lhgbq0gt50_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cji66ob2c9h2bs)**
---
[ Yes, I'll Stand With The Babylon Bee](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zpsh24tb1r7frhadi198t73l5je0t1jrq4f1r898_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cji66ob2c9h2bs)
---
They can hurt us, smear us, reduce our reach; but they can never silence us with free speech supporters like you in our corner. **[Join the fray with us by becoming a Babylon Bee premium subscriber today.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zc8tcfcrbclp7l96lq97n18la0ikn87olsqtee88_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cji66ob2c9h2bs)** Thanks for considering standing with us. We'll stand with you, too.

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zonu8bkpdddvndbro0da3gumjdvdmam23dkb4p88_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cji61oj4cjh2bs) [NO](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znjfmrhaqgpcr4a2f666irqss57r99l281gchgqg_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cji61oj4cjh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. ---
* **Facebook** has deleted our posts and deactivated our account on several occasions.
* **Front** , our internal email service at the time, terminated our account and left us unable to communicate with each other and wider world.
* And, in a particularly ironic move, **Vimeo** permanently suspended the David Horowitz Freedom Center's account because they posted a talk **I gave on censorship. **

---
**It 's clear woke, left-wing tech elitists can't abide by satire that dares mock their progressive orthodoxy**. We're not the only attempted victims of their censorship regime, either. They've gone after our First Amendment ally Musk, too - Disney, Apple, IBM, and Sony are just some of the companies who have pulled their advertising from X to protest the fact that it platforms the Bee and others accused of "wrongthink." All this amounts to a sustained, coordinated attack on free thought and expression. These pillars are central to our mission of speaking truth through humor. **No matter how much pressure they exert, the Bee will never back down. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us**. To people with integrity, like Musk, principles are worth more than money. **But we won 't give them what they want. **We won't stop telling jokes. More importantly, we won't stop telling the _truth_.
---

Sure, you may be thinking, a billionaire like Musk can afford to take the hit when radical Leftists try to force X into conformity and submission. That's what we thought, too, but we noticed something in the midst of the censorship campaigns waged against us - we had a superpower progressives couldn't see. And that's our subscribers. **The Bee could not have taken the stand it did against Twitter if we did not have the support of each and every subscriber**. These are people who appreciate humor, yes, but also believe in free speech. Who appreciate debate, dialogue, and discovering new ideas. **[If that sounds like you, I hope you'll consider subscribing to the Babylon Bee. body:
The Limited Edition Trump Knife Collection is not just a collectible—it’s a legacy of patriotism, precision, and exquisite craftsmanship

| | | | Dear Friend,
Introducing a unique opportunity to own a distinguished piece of American history.
The **[Limited Edition Trump Knife Collection](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z7m0c09dhj5htc8g9gfk8rh1pac0p16ppjh0mfa8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cjh6cor6cth2bs)** is not just a collectible—it’s a legacy of patriotism, precision, and exquisite craftsmanship.
Reserved for those who appreciate the finer things in life, this set is the ultimate tribute to the 45th President of the United States.

---
| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z18ucdb4nmnh40eatkfakiai1i8lg0ac1fgl9cpo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cjh6cor6cth2bs)
---
| | |
**Why the Trump Knife Collection Stands Apart:****8 Distinctive Knives, Each Telling a Story**
This collection is thoughtfully[designed to commemorate pivotal moments from Trump’s presidency](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zlfsa16ljs1bd6oc54hnibb6g09ei9n2ib6cteio_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cjh6cor6cth2bs).
Each month, a new knife arrives at your door, featuring a full-color image of President Trump paired with one of his defining messages—from “Keep America Great” to “Save America Again.”
Each piece is more than a knife; it’s a statement of American pride.
* **Premium Pakkawood Handles** : Hand-polished with a rich cherry stain, each knife handle is crafted to reflect both strength and elegance, offering a balanced, luxurious feel in your hand.
* **Razor-Sharp Stainless Steel Blades** : Each blade is forged with precision, ensuring durability and a sharp edge, reflecting the steadfast spirit of American craftsmanship.
* **American Craftsmanship** : Designed and forged in the USA, each knife is a testament to American quality, pride, and tradition.

---
| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zghmq6q9cqehrc1qh9b5ir8g6uc26c9agrtsf4p8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cjh6cor6cth2bs)
---
| | |
**A Showcase of Elegance: The LED Display Case** The collection comes complete with a **[custom-designed wooden display case](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2ze632soi18dlrmedn6lgev1d76nbuc279poj1hso_rp22sh2s8i6eoj3cjh6cor6cth2bs)** , made from premium cherry wood and featuring a shining gold strip with a hinged glass cover.
The addition of **eight built-in LED lights** enhances the beauty of each knife, casting a soft glow that captures the essence of this elegant tribute.
* **Protective and Elegant** : The hinged cover provides easy access to your knives while ensuring they remain protected from dust and wear.

name: Colin Allred
subject: I have a record of bringing people together
body:
| | | | | |
---
# **Colin Allred**
---
| | | |
---
| | | | I'm a fourth-generation Texan who was raised in Dallas by a single mom. My mother taught in public schools and sometimes even worked an extra job to get by. Thanks to her, my teachers and coaches, and the good folks at our local YMCA, I went on to play football for Baylor and in the NFL before becoming a civil rights lawyer. **Then I ran for Congress to serve the community that raised me.** I'm running for Senate because I don't want my story to be the exception. I want all kids, no matter where they're from or what they're facing, to have what they need to achieve their dreams. **Will you chip in to help me defeat Ted Cruz and give Texas families the senator we deserve? →**
---
| [Donate Now](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2uu4ae-ezxsks-kyd76rh9/)
---
My very first vote in Congress was to expand the Affordable Care Act and make health care more accessible for all Americans. **_Ted Cruz once spent 21 hours speaking out against the ACA on the Senate floor._** Last year, I was proud to be a part of passing a historic infrastructure bill that will bring $35 billion to Texas over the next five years. I also helped pass the CHIPS and Science Act, which is bringing high-tech manufacturing to our state. Ted Cruz voted against both of these **_bipartisan_** bills. **_Ted Cruz would rather deny Texans vital investments we need than reach across the aisle._** He's one of the most divisive legislators in Congress and has spent his whole career pitting people against each other. I have a very different record of bringing people together – in fact, I was just named the most bipartisan member of the Texas delegation. [**_That's the kind of leader I'll be in the Senate, and if you agree Texans deserve better than Ted Cruz's selfish extremism,_**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2uu4ae-ezxskt-kyd76rh0/)[**_I hope you'll chip in on my campaign today. Dear Friend,

I hear from people all the time that Thomas Sowell is one of their heroes. For those people-and you may be among them-I'm thrilled to share a digital copy of one of his commentaries with you, absolutely free: "Trickle Down" Theory and "Tax
Cuts for the Rich."

"Tax cuts for the rich" is a favorite argument of those who oppose lower tax rates. But does imposing higher tax rates on wealthy Americans actually increase the amount of revenue coming into the federal government?

Hoover Institution Senior Fellow Thomas Sowell takes an empirical approach in his commentary, "Trickle Down" Theory and "Tax Cuts for the Rich."

Sowell separates fact from fiction when it comes to tax rates and uses real life data and examples to prove that lower tax rates for all actually lead to greater revenue for the government.

As a friend and supporter of the Hoover Institution, we are proud to offer you this valuable, thought-provoking resource free of charge. Click here to get your free copy of "Trickle Down" Theory and "Tax Cuts for the Rich" now.

Thanks,
Greg

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=847e8fe307874ab4b7fa46635f09733e&_e=sBoPWur55AMZ0ggnI1kkJ3N8t8VRdf_ar-0JLFer3wr2mJWUVteCeTmsBbBYCJMxaw0vut_pFnvc1YwfQqkER06t9YyPbNQU1SnuB-17Kq_fD5uIvhQcWcXU4ia_Yw4TnYzg-h7YpXWsbi87DmZzce59ycWdfDJuEwbFO1e6kssFBbQtjMka9Kz_XojOtpSEXpXsQlrJFDRcMXBPsD-USe9zEJVZwv-_YjxAa8FkxbzGPkBgyR_3eLXmVKM5Oi-Rr-O3oJWZwMWl4XursRNFJkuv6FJc4kEqCf8VngE2q4bqgB2uQ1QMxdk5zJxqpFV3Bz51qsuNgQJ6kTwFx6S8h6p2j3hOGPstonhoPzrlpy7JonWVsdwbCN-EbLpIVL9srXSRFm3nCo3cWj-Qy8-pPLY6WuKQ3tIPzNbQD7aDa-s%3D) [NO](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=847e8fe307874ab4b7fa46635f09733e&_e=sBoPWur55AMZ0ggnI1kkJ3N8t8VRdf_ar-0JLFer3wr2mJWUVteCeTmsBbBYCJMxaw0vut_pFnvc1YwfQqkER06t9YyPbNQU1SnuB-17Kq_fD5uIvhQcWcXU4ia_Yw4TnYzg-h7YpXWsbi87DmZzce59ycWdfDJuEwbFO1e6kssFBbQtjMka9Kz_XojOtpSEXpXsQlrJFDRcMXBPsD-USe9zEJVZwv-_YjxAa8FkxbzGPkBgyR_3eLXmVKM5Oi-Rr-O3oJWZwMWl4XursRNFJmMwsZZZXTmquz_ruvrNLRqs38Bi56-HhlvIZtijwNgV2AzzveIM-5qK3V_LDlW9nswMp2fIlyFjshAqadvOTmUFfyEDIYvLN0UzJNnG4Z4F2ZSqJIIOdjzNkDgXBmfdZc8JXZBkhEa9rh6uEgPVLqA%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. We've been trying to write a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But, in all seriousness - free speech is no joke (not even a multibillion dollar one). The Bee would know - not only did Twitter deplatform us, but other woke Big Tech firms have tried to silence our voice as well.
---
* **Facebook** has deleted our posts and deactivated our account on several occasions.
* **Front** , our internal email service at the time, terminated our account and left us unable to communicate with each other and wider world.
* And, in a particularly ironic move, **Vimeo** permanently suspended the David Horowitz Freedom Center's account because they posted a talk **I gave on censorship. **

---
**It 's clear woke, left-wing tech elitists can't abide by satire that dares mock their progressive orthodoxy**. We're not the only attempted victims of their censorship regime, either. They've gone after our First Amendment ally Musk, too - Disney, Apple, IBM, and Sony are just some of the companies who have pulled their advertising from X to protest the fact that it platforms the Bee and others accused of "wrongthink." All this amounts to a sustained, coordinated attack on free thought and expression. These pillars are central to our mission of speaking truth through humor. **No matter how much pressure they exert, the Bee will never back down. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us**. To people with integrity, like Musk, principles are worth more than money. **But we won 't give them what they want. **We won't stop telling jokes. More importantly, we won't stop telling the _truth_.

# SATURDAY, SEPTEMBER 21, 2024
---|---
**Good Morning**! On this day in 1780, [General Benedict Arnold](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQgOGnwRsWnGkIA0MXb-na0SJwjq_CEMEplt--atWx8zf8-j9vyy1QpvL4CDt6XusSItMLFydBSzCLGZJfEQGnAb22cHFgjdbD5mGya9QRJ-t0WMFdlVmnqKILcEVj00AeFBjlQGulrHHj_W6DSjEgvlljcRJGYSKubfyqVHjDNZ_1hW2MdR-y35ifXUzvAmYB83Ec40adazt_XMDMG3WZwimpyD8RMN-xYKLIMrRSc5Kx7jtxl9ww9FqG5tPzoJypX6ww6rEHyr9B_n__5eE7AAD__9-_Xy0) plotted to hand over West Point to the British in exchange for money and a high position in the British army. The plan was discovered, and Arnold became synonymous with the word "traitor." What's in a name? Loki Skywalker Mowbray faced potential denial of a British passport due to trademark concerns. (See below.) American parents of the [hundreds of children named](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1vgzAQQH8NbEbmOOIweOjClq4d0WGOcJU_IuOA0l9fpXPnJz09va_bdCPxEu-fFNiWNU3kihw8DQpaBThhvdiVGbir2bYGLgMYbNt6s3NPmkivOPfugtfhitQZ7BBdD3TVXS0WNKAeoG21Njg082xIL46Ye4OGuwo1L1JSbr6TxLLx6l_p4Ny4FGpvt1Iee9V9VDBWMJ7n2bjI5Q0rGN3Tl2fmCsZIQeJdzTQL74rWwlktlMumDlo4K9lVSJmVSyGkqMpGUb3SU2UmLz9vQ53t8jjFe9kvpkJ9DyT-L6L8v-Sw8BsAAP__FttlNg) Anakin, Lando, and Leia might want to prepare extra identification for UK travel. Today we're sponsored by [EnergyX](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx80L-O3CAYBPCnwd1a8IGNKSgirbbbtCkRfz7bRIAtzDrZtz_5dOXp2tGvmJk_T_O0McWy_LYZdZs3Y32LJxp1A3YDYUQX9IwIyDvUTMKoQArGulV7MahZcpBunIJzg3OUMqWEZ9ZPI_IuaqAgqALGKJVC9c5JS4O3iIMUEjkRFENsW-3_brG0Fef03k6svd9yl_Ta2n4Q_ovAg8AjlhOP1mPBurz_X-TK-ePVsjm2V_VI-D3k-gWSLSGWZbcLEhgvlDHEVyb8vtvaCtZjjTub6I0P3NBrLoGxFZvx-MEYxgYFDEaYRFd12P_FlOIxSiLokm1Mn93b90-eGj4CAAD__5AOdMc), which is offering an opportunity to invest in a ground-breaking lithium extraction company.

## Secret Service Protection Bill Passes House
The House [unanimously passed a bill](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLHO4yAQhJ8GdxvBhhi5oLjG3X_tlRGBdcwJg8WuHeXtT0l93UgzmtF8f37uPyGXXJ-_w0ZelnYPUfJJ9wnQANq7HZJfiJCuA3njcJzQWWOG1WNKwUw2PdwUJzMag2TcLY43nWi0ix2yR41WT2iM1s5Ol8fDBZ1iILo56-iqrKaUpfXL35arrLSUdzupX2LbhuJXkZ3V9ZfCWeFc33tj-VgK50-xwllPX61wPhgqvVjhvLaDCY4aat7aweUNe2AmhkcuBaiuocZcnyD92HYGpthJgKmfORLsvQlFya1CoZMKhEWog7waBBHadqEEgTkw5xo-uc_m0H3aX7mUzKNTVj-3kMv3hfyf6enxXwAAAP__rVN87Q) enhancing Secret Service protection for former President Trump and other officials following two assassination attempts on the Republican nominee. By a 405-0 vote, lawmakers [directed the Secret Service](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLHO4yAQBp8GOiJYsAkFxTXucu2V1trexHvCxjKbRHn706X-u-_TFCPNn9t4Qy68P37jRlnudcRZ-EVjMuAMhDHoJd-JgLym7CL0CWJwTq-5m_xCrp-9T35yvpsRME4QEK99CkvUnMFCsAmcszaGdJmmiHaZkaiLIZJXwdLCUs_L38q7rHQvn_qi8zLXTZe8ihxN-V8KBgWDrLRyKf-ZgmGtG-30bt_5bKRgCNdkO9uZ7zcTl2LkfG6HaTQ_T5aPwdawNd5RuO4GRWg7RMGgz7wcby6FWx9VsI8N-SvS8nOSV4Z_AQAA__8MrWT3) to use uniform standards in determining agent numbers for protecting presidents, vice presidents, and major candidates. The bipartisan bill, [introduced after the first assassination attempt](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1urDAQRp_GdEb2MKyhcHEbur1tSuSfYZnIi1e2A8rbR5s63Sd9OjrS-bivd8eJj8d_9yTbtry60PikdZagJeCKXbQbEdDQkdUGbjMY1LrbLWAYB5ziGEeMg6Fww6DDGCc_bX6e5o4tKEA1g9ZKGZx7741TMTii0aChQaCiyC2X_jPz0Xba0nc-qfQhP7tk99ZeVQz_BCwCluu6-uDrQVd9_wKW9xSwVAqFmqxUTg4k9_xVSXpOSb4KVY50NHZJBndEjq7Rm-mKja-LU-J6MwLV4-k4_Wrb3xFOCz8BAAD__yGRYQo) on Trump in July at a rally in Pennsylvania, is separate from proposed measures that would approve additional funding for the Secret Service. It's unclear if the Senate plans to consider the measure.
## Three Mile Island to Reopen
Constellation Energy [will reopen Three Mile Island nuclear plant](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyhCAQgOGngY4bWFHOgiKN3aVN6aywnptBcJCYubfPJHXqv_hnvo_H_EBOnJ_vuJNva5kxNL5oHhUYBXa2MvqVCKiT5I2DYQRnjZGbN4O7B4dr19u1HxERXW97HR0srhuGRbIHDVaPYIzWzo63ZXGoY0Ci3llHnbCaIrdSb5-Fc9toTa9yUb2Fssvkt9aOU3RvAiYBU9to45R-m4DpKInDS8BEmerzpShfXEveKTcBk72P2vVGta0SqZ0TKT4T5qjyV0iEVR0Jc1OVykFZ7RxqOcvaVCRMAiZZfTy-OSU-Byesfu7If2fZ_je6PPwEAAD__wYeauc), infamous for its 1979 meltdown, to power Microsoft's data centers. Constellation is [set to invest $1.6 billion](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAQRn8N3rDgTEwZGLp4S9eO1hmO-CpsIkzj9t9Xydztkz7pPel9Xucrcub99oEb-ZbKjKHxg2YnQUsws-miT0RAQ0deWxgdWKN1t3oFS0pv8RJAqWiStuOCeHF2TI7cgEvHHhQY5UBrpaxx_bJYVDEg0cUaS4MwiiK3UvuvwntbKeXf8qDah7J12a-t3Q8xvAuYBEznefb4w-V4vgKmJ1vApNxrC5jaWonkxpkkHxn3KPfvkAmr3DjUcpTUJLKMhLmrPt5PzpmP0Qqjbhtyflnb_w0eHv4CAAD__9V9Xi4) to revive the reactor, pending approval by the Nuclear Regulatory Commission approval, as well as securing state and local permits. Microsoft announced it signed [a 20-year deal](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvgzAQRn-N2S4yh4vD4KELW7p2RMacw7XGRrZJlH9fkbnbkz7p6dP7vk03y4Hj_ctuZKpPk3WVHzQNgC2gmlSzGE-E1DVkWo39gFq1bbOaYbn2Xe-k072bPcmrdlL3RHqQ3s7LtWGDEpUcsG2l1Gq4zLO2cnGW6EMrTZ1QkhauKV9-Ese6kg-v9KB8cWlrgllr3YvoPgWOAsf42lOp5yRwPMUCRzm8WeA4H4UjlSJw5Ojtlo4Cdc1EsHEg4BJsXIALzNb9wskbu5xK8hWeNtYCXAvEwwWyGfb0pAw1gT8ogGWw28yVUzz9TTbL_uQQuPRaKHnfLIf35fp_wIfBvwAAAP__oPx02w) with the energy firm to purchase all power from the restarted reactor, aiming to fuel its AI-driven data centers with carbon-free energy by 2028. Three Mile Island could potentially create 3,400 jobs and contribute $16 billion to the state's economy, Constellation officials say.
## What to Watch This Weekend
As football season progresses, networks and streaming services are launching new and returning shows, many of which appeal to nostalgia. [You can see a list here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FurDAQQNGvsbtF47HBULh4Dd2-JkVKNOBhmchgBBYofx9p06Y_utL9fA5PkiTb6z-tHMqcB5qKXDx0DzQPdIPTMczMyFZzMB6bDr0zRi-BamjBoXdz65lwIqoNNHNtfIS6tVZLQEAHHRoD4F1XjaMniBMx1955tsoBRyn5qL6ybGXhOX3ni49qyqtOYSllP5X9p7BX2N_3XZVLtlPir1DYn0u-T4X9RIm3SMdb2g_eC68jH_oIcb8lJTkbrxy8VpL0jpe_V6-APwEAAP__zjVV7A). Paramount+ showcases [three Hollywood icons](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjz1vwyAUAH8NbLbggUM8MHTxlq4dLT4e8aswWDax1X9fpXPX00mn-3rMD0eZyvPTrWhbqrMLjU6cxw5kB3rWPNqECKg4WmngNoLRUvLFGpnUoFXwQQgpRPTB3c2Q7kN0yid_42RBgBYjSCmE0WPvvXEiBoc4GG1QMS0wUqt7_12ptAVT_qkn7n2oK892aW07mPpgMDGYruvqIz2pudx2LPF4WwymtZ6EB4Op4NXV0m1ud2t9ldZt-fXmfLdxuyhnOm6GafFcHeW_RPt_-LTwGwAA___L3Fmn) in its lineup: Sylvester Stallone in "Tulsa King" and Kelsey Grammer reprising his role in the "Frasier" revival. Rounding out the star-studded offerings, Oscar-winner Kathy Bates leads a reboot of the classic series "Matlock." Max debuted "[The Penguin](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz79yrSAQgPGngQ4HVjxcCorb2J20KR2EVTeDfwb3aPL2maRO_RXf_N6fwzNSoW1-iysGnvYhJqYLB6_AKLCDlTlMiICtxGAcPDw4a4xcwtSOujPWWNN1gA7caJxxyU86p8c_nyQF0GC1B2O0dtY34-iizikids46bIXVmIn32nzstPGCU_naL6xN2ldZwsJ8nKL9L6AX0N_33fA1vyjjTxfQb3ifAnpeUB24zS_a1Bo_VcWC8USVI6PiGqlgVSmeLKCXNeTjplLofDhh9bxGKr87_ht_BfgOAAD__1qZXNw)" to classic comic book fans this week, with Colin Farrell reprising his role from 2022's "The Batman." This dark, gritty series offers a fresh take on one of Batman's most recognizable villains. For the more daring, Netflix's "[Monsters](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyrCAUgOGnwQ4HDqxcC4rb2G3alA7CQdkg7MhZnX37TFKn_pt_vs_7fHcpp7J-uB0txTo7T-nEeeQgOehZd8FGREDVoZUGhhGMlrLbrFLg_U2JQXnnQcYohNNxkXHURvh_uksWBGgxgpRCGD32y2KcCN4h3ow2qJgWGBLVo3_UVGjDmN_1xKP3de-y3Yiejan_DCYG03VdPZ3rKwX86QymgldjMO21NMKDN3StFg78wIyuIQ-OkLfX8kBP3LtG3JXA8cTjTVsqK6fKv0q9GEzdYcPzSjmnNhimxbq7lH836G-U08J3AAAA__9A5WZo)" series returns with a look into the notorious case of Lyle and Erik Menendez, brothers who shocked the nation and grabbed headlines by murdering their parents in 1989.

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c4e2a195846b4b82b83e6ab6298656ed&_e=dcliW-g6m_wSOKw6T1znazfZOd4eCuzayjq8fRLxi1smIVchswO1BskBKlEMHvpAiTGUA31HSe59dWwwVoCzVomdwVsFHdIhZZmQPvCQbsfFAgz6wGMj8kaUviLYU_Ca2S6sbJ6h9caMGOJwv0KY84IbHcp6gT23NZx4aQahFlesHjjV-KZikZ-ZzdKqCxrpJqbGVIZ6X-6m-8f6IbT6isR4FBuUzALTjilTNeki85q4Nk53jAeTkFZzFEp7qRvSAdGYqWJIGTfwjOi-yynzpUXwoWPdhcaulkcZkPl_BBTuqEjQrcv83UZshJVQBWz_yi8hD78Jl_-7eq5gMyyijUWNOHI7rtIeDnLtbuJndoEyRqrKL7hpfpZ7jq3zykVj_GoFove7o34Gx799no8c-mukfvHG6o79lqQ0sxFK6sU%3D) [NO](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c4e2a195846b4b82b83e6ab6298656ed&_e=dcliW-g6m_wSOKw6T1znazfZOd4eCuzayjq8fRLxi1smIVchswO1BskBKlEMHvpAiTGUA31HSe59dWwwVoCzVomdwVsFHdIhZZmQPvCQbsfFAgz6wGMj8kaUviLYU_Ca2S6sbJ6h9caMGOJwv0KY84IbHcp6gT23NZx4aQahFlesHjjV-KZikZ-ZzdKqCxrpJqbGVIZ6X-6m-8f6IbT6isR4FBuUzALTjilTNeki85q4Nk53jAeTkFZzFEp7qRvSAdGYqWJIGTfwjOi-yynzpR-9AEx5sibXVjlrMLJe-vnMfqIniUtFWxQNlVKMWbVX70cWy3bnKHzFj0Z1Up3eSnUMvtCuEfQyeFOc_8IdiXSAgUcuSVlFWWpPWSv2L1-oJfy_gH6SO7kMiaM79yZK2qIVaWvoaVhNQMuCW1BsM3s%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c4e2a195846b4b82b83e6ab6298656ed&_e=dcliW-g6m_wSOKw6T1znazfZOd4eCuzayjq8fRLxi1smIVchswO1BskBKlEMHvpAiTGUA31HSe59dWwwVoCzVomdwVsFHdIhZZmQPvCQbsfFAgz6wGMj8kaUviLYU_Ca2S6sbJ6h9caMGOJwv0KY84IbHcp6gT23NZx4aQahFlesHjjV-KZikZ-ZzdKqCxrpJqbGVIZ6X-6m-8f6IbT6isR4FBuUzALTjilTNeki85q4Nk53jAeTkFZzFEp7qRvSAdGYqWJIGTfwjOi-yynzpfnKGz7mHAE06VH26Wjuel1skaadfX0lKcMDdhVJHf0nfUymKZPxa6G4taL_k36wavszMjvobgDciOnWZ3ATUBB2fHBq03dRgAAJZM_1SY5-dJhoHRA1cvqGxWpGLnxuiODX3ifqoIrns2_i8EfJ-II%3D)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| | Dear Friends, It’s been a busy and productive week on the campaign trail, and I wanted to share some of the highlights with you! _**Saturday Meet & Greets in Shawnee and Prairie Village**_

---
---
This past Saturday, I had the pleasure of attending multiple meet-and-greet events in Shawnee and Prairie Village. It was energizing to speak with so many of you about the issues that matter most—whether it’s boosting our local economy, ensuring top-quality education for our children, or keeping our communities safe. Your support and enthusiasm are what fuel this campaign, and I’m grateful for every conversation we had. _**Door Knocking with Young Republicans and Senator Kellie Warren**_**
** While I was meeting with voters, the **Johnson County Young Republicans** and **Senator Kellie Warren** were out in Leawood knocking on doors to help spread the word about our campaign. Their hard work and dedication mean so much to me, and together we’re making sure that voters know what’s at stake in this election. _**Thursday Meeting with SMSD Superintendent****
**_On Thursday, I had a fantastic meeting with the superintendent of the**Shawnee Mission School District (SMSD)**. We talked about the challenges the district is facing, including **truancy** , but I also learned about the incredible opportunities they’re providing for students to succeed in the workforce. One particularly inspiring story was about a student who developed an app to detect the early stages of **Parkinson's disease** —a true example of the innovation coming out of our public schools. It’s moments like these that reinforce my commitment to being an advocate and champion for **public education**. _**Friday Morning Meeting with KS Orthopedic Society**_**** On Friday, I met with members of the **Kansas Orthopedic Society** at **KU Med Center** to discuss some of the pressing issues in healthcare. We had meaningful conversations about **physician reimbursement** and the growing concerns around **cybersecurity** in hospitals. As a doctor, I understand how important it is to support healthcare professionals while ensuring that patient data remains secure. These are issues I’m committed to addressing when elected to Congress. _**Business Visit with SafeDefend**_**
**
---
---
Earlier in the week, I also had the opportunity to visit **SafeDefend** , a local company focused on workplace and school safety solutions. Their innovative technology is a game changer when it comes to protecting our schools and businesses from active threats. I’m committed to advocating for safety measures like these to keep our communities secure. As we continue this journey together, I want to thank you for your support and involvement. Whether you’re knocking on doors, sharing our message with friends, or donating your time or resources, you’re making a difference. _**Join Us This Week**_**
**[**Don’t forget, I’ll be hosting our weekly Sunday evening Zoom call at 8:30 PM.**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/6dcc10b8ddad76db322761119fed00b9/43823/4225ec8bb7bae2233947229f28c3afba/d43502802a68ace5c3d6b838967d376c/43823)**** It’s a great chance for me to connect with you, share campaign updates, and hear your thoughts. I hope you’ll join us! Thank you for being a part of this campaign. Together, we can build a brighter future for Kansas. Best regards,

name: The Liberty Ledger
subject: Will you share your thoughts on the free market?
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.libertyledger._RhdU8ErwzA)
---
| |
Dear fellow American, Time magazine published a story featuring the headline, "The Free Market is Dead: What Will Replace It?"

This is, of course, an exaggeration, but it makes clear the far-Left's goal--nothing less than a transformation of the world economy based on a rejection of economist Adam Smith's "invisible hand."

As the author writes, "We are on the cusp of a new era of broad-based prosperity in which our leaders are poised to more actively manage the American market."

Today's advocates of a "managed market" may call it by a new name--"The Great Reset"--but it is premised on an old and harmful idea.

What utopian ideologies like this one have in common is a misplaced faith in the rule of so-called experts and a corresponding disregard for the people's right to rule themselves. Taken to their logical conclusion, such ideologies can end only in **tyranny**.

The great British statesman Winston Churchill knew this, which led him to observe, "Nothing would be more fatal than for the government of states to get into the hands of the experts. Expert knowledge is limited knowledge: and the unlimited ignorance of the plain man who knows only what hurts is a safer guide, than any vigorous direction of a specialised character."

**In the fight to preserve our freedom, our greatest asset is education.** Americans who understand our country's founding principles and have a firm grasp of history are best prepared to resist the lure of utopian schemes.

**[That's why Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in our FREE MARKET SURVEY.](http://trk.libertyledger.)**

Your answers will help us understand more clearly the views of mainstream Americans--not the so-called experts--concerning the importance of the free market system in our nation.

Please begin your survey below. Your answers will remain strictly confidential.

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/free-market-survey/](http://trk.libertyledger._wSuU2A)**

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 **_[Hillsdale College National Survey on the Free Market and Economic Liberty](http://trk.libertyledger._1LMSAVpHyXsNuw)_** **1\. Do you believe that the Constitution made it possible for America to become the freest and most prosperous nation in history?**

There are less than 50 days until we elect Vice President Harris and Governor Walz to the White House -- and we can’t do it without you. **Remember:_When we fight, we win._** ⬇️ Keep scrolling to learn more about what Team Harris-Walz has been up to lately. ⬇️
* * *
**FROM THE TRAIL: CONTINUING TO CHART A “NEW WAY FORWARD”** [](https://click.contact.kamalaharris.com/ss/c/u001.IrwCNRMzSkXvFsTjBP9k2GHFkvh1IMUjv9kHvyDN3nMInQOG1CTF_EtnFEZr6Oj5nNS59PXWWHcsnP1h7aZyOHB1mfFtDrvZ5_whFDreMG950_ZOSBvOel4Mn8ZB2uQxLs1CL3ypLKEK2mYR1hN5jZ5FjUy1aZxI0WIt8ASDHU7Smj6olPzTh9aNaMEuTCO-xJDlOYdJCff1sZs_wB4jHlGrwsJFbCS0NN2or0qEqZUxn_4ohuII-fDEJ_qOw6qlYnVrLqCTRw3B3lWtqnNbKsOLhpGQejGS3BYlCSSgYiMsddL-ROmojAMf7NBdoJt4GkzTlimGJ3dL4nTXYrHiuPDDx6vlhzkCNMC8kZsYbMEdT2nzrv1QDW4PCgBcInzP/49y/DJUu5wNTSMGlfj0usuQInA/h1/h001.yO9QeD-N4opOBrtcSdCr04Y4hihsfZDsFqnsIfSHSjM) Coming off of her decisive debate victory, Vice President Kamala Harris, Governor Tim Walz, Second Gentleman Douglas Emhoff, Gwen Walz, and dozens of campaign surrogates criss-crossed the country to share their vision of a New Way Forward with voters in battleground states. The New Way Forward Tour made waves on the air, online, and in print as the Harris-Walz campaign got out into the communities who will decide this election to underscore the stark contrast in this election. **Most recently, on National Voter Registration Day, Team Harris-Walz and the Democratic National Committee launched a Youth Vote Week of Action to encourage young voters across the battlegrounds to register to vote. This all-hands-on-deck mobilization will reach young voters where they are -- online and in person, on campuses, and in their communities -- and continue to forge our path to victory.**
* * *
**FROM THE TRAIL: KICKING OFF HISPANIC HERITAGE MONTH** [](https://click.contact.kamalaharris.com/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMRzWUMjCcCLrGZpT2ZgECa5gsBa0enU7PMQdvg2cJWxOmz_uq9DmHYVhKZPRGGq6rQDjV5ldyGhhtJJJr67RfW0KjlZmLJMsb36Mz2f-AZt7SqXfY-NEazfGU0SGuKcHL53Loe7qi7U9MYL_s-uOOebvLIx1T3rVkMu7DhbOsZkPxmZCqnMwrrAbvPwLzr-q3y3C3E5irQZx4dcWJUIS3i1u4nUOmCo219xp1Y-HGNq6bmg9DdMv0NOde_X3dSQq04Vv1PCaQSRSeTWxTK3EkPfdnyQW-fBplTOmm5TJBhim-1R_oUgESnAww7gke1a8LIfExlUiHzCKTmHdV17VJHc/49y/DJUu5wNTSMGlfj0usuQInA/h2/h001.cfdPaFHfwn0rq0D731L-EETJTCuTvPHD7s16gaAOibU) Team Harris-Walz launched historic actions to engage, reach, and mobilize Latino voters as Hispanic Heritage Month kicks off. “Hispanic Heritage Month is an important moment to celebrate the richness and diversity of Latino communities across the country,” said Harris-Walz Campaign Manager Julie Chavez Rodriguez. “Building on our historic efforts to break through and earn the support of Latino voters everywhere, this Hispanic Heritage Month will be a key part of our aggressive campaign efforts to make our case to voters about Vice President Harris, who has spent her entire career fighting for Latino families, and as president, will always focus on the issues that our community cares most deeply about.” **These efforts build on existing programs designed to meet Latinos where they are, like the campaign’s first-of-its-kind _[Latinos con Harris-Walz](https://click.contact.kamalaharris.com/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMRzWUMjCcCLrGZpT2ZgECa5gsBa0enU7PMQdvg2cJWxOmz_uq9DmHYVhKZPRGGq6rVeKCot0e1eM5sF_0nlt54rc24Mj1eY-gc-yAc3XtnP8MDT2wHjcJIncGbIqNt_yUAMp0ZAIH9bzrrGQHaCAWJbkuCb42wLiPD7xwpq6hjq0AavLJMDIukUok-AMwt-aFqEzNlGsgnxvKlC36rUH42lIQbVq23IbRKeUd39dJcVzFs2OqE5BIjcYX7slCxUgL2Zw6hCst1VtCSWwcGQdBBmmmETqAcAz5l6Qyo24yXWNv2KGmSpU1JglNeWaExEbTs3Es6czVnUCi8NLZyOHZD4/49y/DJUu5wNTSMGlfj0usuQInA/h3/h001.Lp4A7LHFGVii4PvyE-xUtcc47IoaUkuoUaZ0bn24fFA)_ WhatsApp channel. To reach Latino voters in an increasingly dynamic media environment, these organizing efforts along with our WhatsApp channel target Latino voters with tailored, culturally competent content that reflects the Latino community.**
* * *
**SUPPORTER SPOTLIGHT: BRIAN IN TOKYO, JAPAN** [](https://click.contact.kamalaharris.com/ss/c/u001.NV3IV8RXB3BPG-RgoenRivizIuY7_hyRTlr0Ev1A4jyRess_Z46ivJQExIi6hcFA-oeaOxFWwIgjoJpx8zpDpmDWqk5UA8fawUKjj-qtiONmtxl4DxH-jL5F_xVQYCc_4MlO1np8ZhMF6hhW5OW4CpyU1mzLHyq5hTtP3fXuWrUFMHlrb7gU7RMDWfvvCEPyW2bE5caYA4sWhPjK3bPEF-tLd1dA5S-CYwe5QR-mIbDZ-OKonIRiZM2Z8kz79Qp_XgSJkT6CoTAZSg_rQV7kmNmC62-Fn-6vtdQB9UugMi0j1-hD8KBACE9D_JXWJIFrMP4fR-7zntOM3jbU-QNc8qBh4sRoaitnK0IMLQpzLLHNjtZi1aT0oe1TIZ_g22vRpsigIY8q8bxlh5jYewn9wiEGqXKG0g3HR_d_oGxRTEE3fAnajji0cBdMq3dG8bQifV3lqViQ4PnkORhtGAQWm4-0pUvkRi_VA7jyG2t27_JHR-Zk1SO3Rk4zOsdGfYu0T_ex61-GYYquje8EmfvzTLTzwYCibv_1u1DqR7u-XCb1-qwxIeHN6SQLC7KtDOVW71KRHNWDFoFLEYeUvnXQ56tQNK8XI0JoH8USnb5nwKc/49y/DJUu5wNTSMGlfj0usuQInA/h4/h001.5KqujHPZUMSlAs5qnXMZRBeiMLnpr9SIqEQ1UfwuyoQ) Brian is a retired US Navy Captain from Gresham, Oregon. He is a registered Republican, but stands by his beliefs: “Come hell or high water I am voting for Harris and Walz.” He is especially focused on the Trump campaign’s policies against women’s reproductive health and Project 2025. After hearing Vice President Harris’s speech at the DNC, he was not only reassured, but felt encouraged and hopeful by her message. In his own community, he’s determined to get the people around him to understand the importance of this election. He says that, for the first time ever, he is going to vote for every Democrat on every ballot. He supports Team Harris-Walz because he knows that our ticket will usher in a brighter future for all of America. **From our campaign to you: Thank you, Brian, for your dedication to electing Vice President Harris!**

clean_body: Read on to find out more about how to join us as we elect Vice President Harris and defeat Donald Trump! | | | Peter, It was another busy week for Vice President Harris and Governor Walz who have been criss-crossing the battleground states, releasing new ads, talking to voters, outlining their vision for a New Way Forward, fighting for women’s reproductive freedom, and much, much, more. There are less than 50 days until we elect Vice President Harris and Governor Walz to the White House -- and we can’t do it without you. Remember:When we fight, we win. ⬇️ Keep scrolling to learn more about what Team Harris-Walz has been up to lately. ⬇️ FROM THE TRAIL: CONTINUING TO CHART A “NEW WAY FORWARD” Coming off of her decisive debate victory, Vice President Kamala Harris, Governor Tim Walz, Second Gentleman Douglas Emhoff, Gwen Walz, and dozens of campaign surrogates criss-crossed the country to share their vision of a New Way Forward with voters in battleground states. The New Way Forward Tour made waves on the air, online, and in print as the Harris-Walz campaign got out into the communities who will decide this election to underscore the stark contrast in this election. Most recently, on National Voter Registration Day, Team Harris-Walz and the Democratic National Committee launched a Youth Vote Week of Action to encourage young voters across the battlegrounds to register to vote. This all-hands-on-deck mobilization will reach young voters where they are -- online and in person, on campuses, and in their communities -- and continue to forge our path to victory. FROM THE TRAIL: KICKING OFF HISPANIC HERITAGE MONTH Team Harris-Walz launched historic actions to engage, reach, and mobilize Latino voters as Hispanic Heritage Month kicks off. “Hispanic Heritage Month is an important moment to celebrate the richness and diversity of Latino communities across the country,” said Harris-Walz Campaign Manager Julie Chavez Rodriguez. “Building on our historic efforts to break through and earn the support of Latino voters everywhere, this Hispanic Heritage Month will be a key part of our aggressive campaign efforts to make our case to voters about Vice President Harris, who has spent her entire career fighting for Latino families, and as president, will always focus on the issues that our community cares most deeply about.” These efforts build on existing programs designed to meet Latinos where they are, like the campaign’s first-of-its-kind WhatsApp channel. To reach Latino voters in an increasingly dynamic media environment, these organizing efforts along with our WhatsApp channel target Latino voters with tailored, culturally competent content that reflects the Latino community. SUPPORTER SPOTLIGHT: BRIAN IN TOKYO, JAPAN Brian is a retired US Navy Captain from Gresham, Oregon. He is a registered Republican, but stands by his beliefs: “Come hell or high water I am voting for Harris and Walz.” He is especially focused on the Trump campaign’s policies against women’s reproductive health and Project 2025. After hearing Vice President Harris’s speech at the DNC, he was not only reassured, but felt encouraged and hopeful by her message. In his own community, he’s determined to get the people around him to understand the importance of this election. He says that, for the first time ever, he is going to vote for every Democrat on every ballot. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1955%2E135344%2E3i3ZDX)

Friends --
I know that you are busy and this is one of hundreds of emails in your inbox, so I will keep it quick. Since the general election officially kicked off after the primary in early August, our race has been flooded with attack ads. This is what we prepare for in the year leading up to now, but I thought it might be instructive to lay out how these attack ads work, and the sheer amount of money being spent in the most competitive open Senate seat in the country.
Starting on August 7th – immediately following the primary – we’ve seen nearly $9 million in spending by One Nation, a top outside spender with ties to Mitch McConnell, in three media markets across Michigan – Detroit, Lansing, and Flint.
Nearly $4 million from the National Republican Senatorial Committee, the organization with the sole purpose of flipping the Senate red.
Almost $3 million from Great Lakes Conservative Fund, a PAC bankrolled in part by a single, conservative billionaire.
$500,000 worth of TV ads from the American Fuel and Petrochemical Manufacturers Association PAC.
So in total, we have seen upwards of $20 million (!!!!) in spending on attack ads against us on TV, with millions more in digital advertising.
Millions more in TV reservations have been placed over the next few weeks. And who knows how much more they have planned, as we head to the final, competitive weeks of the election.
We always knew this would be an expensive race, but with just 45 days to go, this is where the rubber meets the road. We’re in the thick of it. And while they lather on the attack ads, we need to keep putting out strong, positive content to cut through the noise of the attack ads against us.
[**So, from the heat of the fight, are you willing to chip in $3 to help us fight back against the tsunami of attack ads from conservative super PACs?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240921-1-900&t=2&akid=1955%2E135344%2E3i3ZDX)

Since the general election officially kicked off after the primary in early August, our race has been flooded with attack ads. This is what we prepare for in the year leading up to now, but I thought it might be instructive to lay out how these attack ads work, and the sheer amount of money being spent in the most competitive open Senate seat in the country. Starting on August 7th – immediately following the primary – we’ve seen nearly $9 million in spending by One Nation, a top outside spender with ties to Mitch McConnell, in three media markets across Michigan – Detroit, Lansing, and Flint. Nearly $4 million from the National Republican Senatorial Committee, the organization with the sole purpose of flipping the Senate red. Almost $3 million from Great Lakes Conservative Fund, a PAC bankrolled in part by a single, conservative billionaire. $500,000 worth of TV ads from the American Fuel and Petrochemical Manufacturers Association PAC. So in total, we have seen upwards of $20 million (!!!!) in spending on attack ads against us on TV, with millions more in digital advertising. Millions more in TV reservations have been placed over the next few weeks. And who knows how much more they have planned, as we head to the final, competitive weeks of the election. name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Help us defeat the "woke" mind virus!
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/msla?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend, **What’s the biggest challenge America faces?**

You might think it is $35 trillion of national debt? Or maybe you imagine its uncontrolled immigration? How about inflation, which is still stubbornly high?

**These are all really important problems, but they are not impossible to solve.**

If there is the political will, we could cut government spending dramatically to close the deficit. Who says we need to have all those federal agencies and welfare programs?

Immigration laws could actually be enforced if the federal government put its mind to it. What do you think Japan does to illegal migrants who outstay their welcome?

Inflation can be tamed. Ronald Reagan showed this was possible back in the early 1980s.

**What America cannot do is fix these problems if young Americans grow up thinking the worst about their country.**
---
|
---
_Believe the best about America!_
| Over the past generation, the radical left has slowly marched through America’s institutions. They have captured many colleges and classrooms, promoting an extreme intersectional ideology.

**Young Americans have been taught that their country is always in the wrong.** Instead of celebrating this country’s history, they have been invited to judge everyone and everything that happened by the standards of today.

This has demoralized America, and is sapping the country’s confidence.

**That is why the Mississippi Center for Public Policy, as part of a national movement to push back against the ‘woke’ tide, runs the Mississippi Leadership Academy.**
---
|
---
_Mississippi Leadership Academy_
| This two-part course aimed at high school students is the perfect antidote to ‘woke’ with courses on:
* The moral case for the free market.
* Ethical Leadership.
* Opportunity and our state.
* How the legislative process works.
* American Exceptionalism.
* The Meaning of the Declaration of Independence.

Previous speakers have included Attorney General, Lynn Fitch, State Auditor, Shad White and leading academics. Our Academy is designed to equip students with the skills and knowledge necessary to be effective change agents in our state.

Those that take part have the opportunity to meet state leaders, and in previous years, a number of those that graduated went on the intern with state leaders.
---
|
---
_Current state leaders and future state leaders_
| Do you have children or grandchildren that would benefit from taking part? Please forward this email to them with details on how to sign up below!

The two-part course will take place at our Jackson offices on **_Saturday October 12 th and Saturday November 9th, between 10am and 3pm_**.

Hurry to apply now before places fill, by clicking below!

name: The Babylon Bee
subject: Free speech is no joke
body:
When Elon Musk bought Twitter, he sent me a DM that said, “Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor.”

| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/vOeeiguaMLNXwnbYPn-Znw~~/AARclAA~/RgRo0VCEP0RRaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU9HVDU1MTA2VwNzcGNCCmbq9r_uZv5odBFSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)

|
---
Friend, When Elon Musk bought Twitter, he sent me a DM that said, "Do you want the Babylon Bee restored? There will be no censorship of humor."
---
[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/vOeeiguaMLNXwnbYPn-Znw~~/AARclAA~/RgRo0VCEP0RRaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU9HVDU1MTA2VwNzcGNCCmbq9r_uZv5odBFSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)
---
We've been trying to write a joke worth $44 billion ever since. But, in all seriousness - free speech is no joke (not even a multibillion dollar one). The Bee would know - not only did Twitter deplatform us, but other woke Big Tech firms have tried to silence our voice as well.
---
* **Facebook** has deleted our posts and deactivated our account on several occasions.
* **Front** , our internal email service at the time, terminated our account and left us unable to communicate with each other and wider world.
* And, in a particularly ironic move, **Vimeo** permanently suspended the David Horowitz Freedom Center's account because they posted a talk **I gave on censorship. **

---
**It 's clear woke, left-wing tech elitists can't abide by satire that dares mock their progressive orthodoxy**. We're not the only attempted victims of their censorship regime, either. They've gone after our First Amendment ally Musk, too - Disney, Apple, IBM, and Sony are just some of the companies who have pulled their advertising from X to protest the fact that it platforms the Bee and others accused of "wrongthink." All this amounts to a sustained, coordinated attack on free thought and expression. These pillars are central to our mission of speaking truth through humor. **No matter how much pressure they exert, the Bee will never back down. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us**. To people with integrity, like Musk, principles are worth more than money. **But we won 't give them what they want. **We won't stop telling jokes. More importantly, we won't stop telling the _truth_.
---
[ Join The Fight - Subscribe to The Babylon Bee ](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/vOeeiguaMLNXwnbYPn-Znw~~/AARclAA~/RgRo0VCEP0RRaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU9HVDU1MTA2VwNzcGNCCmbq9r_uZv5odBFSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)
---
Sure, you may be thinking, a billionaire like Musk can afford to take the hit when radical Leftists try to force X into conformity and submission. That's what we thought, too, but we noticed something in the midst of the censorship campaigns waged against us - we had a superpower progressives couldn't see. And that's our subscribers. **The Bee could not have taken the stand it did against Twitter if we did not have the support of each and every subscriber**. These are people who appreciate humor, yes, but also believe in free speech. Who appreciate debate, dialogue, and discovering new ideas. **[If that sounds like you, I hope you'll consider subscribing to the Babylon Bee. We'd love to have you in the fight for freedom of expression.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/vOeeiguaMLNXwnbYPn-Znw~~/AARclAA~/RgRo0VCEP0RRaHR0cHM6Ly9iYWJ5bG9uYmVlLmNvbS9wbGFucz91dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9YWUmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU9HVDU1MTA2VwNzcGNCCmbq9r_uZv5odBFSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA)**

---
* **Facebook** has deleted our posts and deactivated our account on several occasions.
* **Front** , our internal email service at the time, terminated our account and left us unable to communicate with each other and wider world.
* And, in a particularly ironic move, **Vimeo** permanently suspended the David Horowitz Freedom Center's account because they posted a talk **I gave on censorship. **

---
**It 's clear woke, left-wing tech elitists can't abide by satire that dares mock their progressive orthodoxy**. We're not the only attempted victims of their censorship regime, either. They've gone after our First Amendment ally Musk, too - Disney, Apple, IBM, and Sony are just some of the companies who have pulled their advertising from X to protest the fact that it platforms the Bee and others accused of "wrongthink." All this amounts to a sustained, coordinated attack on free thought and expression. These pillars are central to our mission of speaking truth through humor. **No matter how much pressure they exert, the Bee will never back down. Free speech is worth more than whatever they can take from us**. To people with integrity, like Musk, principles are worth more than money. **But we won 't give them what they want. **We won't stop telling jokes. More importantly, we won't stop telling the _truth_.

And that's our subscribers. **The Bee could not have taken the stand it did against Twitter if we did not have the support of each and every subscriber**. name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: What you can do right now to ensure we win this election
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
Time is ticking. If we all do all our part, I know we can win.
| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93277520/499948094/623074613?refcode=jtk1379-fr-nd1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGQyMWRhZDAtMjE3OC1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=TjFhv5eGdldb7d_xxwELcfIBSd5FR98YojbXyWhZQzk=&emci=a56f6e2a-8877-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=8d21dad0-2178-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=9329426)
---
Friend,
I know you're as motivated as I am to defeat Donald Trump, send Kamala Harris to the White House, and elect Democrats up and down the ballot this November.
**1\. Register to vote. **
This election is shaping up to be extremely close. We can't take a single vote for granted. With voter registration deadlines varying by state (and many approaching quickly), be sure you are registered to vote. You can register or check your voter registration status [**here**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93277522/499948096/-1612268846?refcode=jtk1379-fr-nd1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGQyMWRhZDAtMjE3OC1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=TjFhv5eGdldb7d_xxwELcfIBSd5FR98YojbXyWhZQzk=&emci=a56f6e2a-8877-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=8d21dad0-2178-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=9329426).
**2\. Sign up for a volunteer shift.**
We have work to do to organize our communities and get out the vote. Whether it's knocking doors, making phone calls, or something else, there are lots of ways to get involved.
You can look [**here**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93277524/499948099/596296991?refcode=jtk1379-fr-nd1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGQyMWRhZDAtMjE3OC1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=TjFhv5eGdldb7d_xxwELcfIBSd5FR98YojbXyWhZQzk=&emci=a56f6e2a-8877-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=8d21dad0-2178-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=9329426) for opportunities via the Connecticut Democratic Party.
You can look [**here**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93277527/499948101/-1399609589?refcode=jtk1379-fr-nd1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGQyMWRhZDAtMjE3OC1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=TjFhv5eGdldb7d_xxwELcfIBSd5FR98YojbXyWhZQzk=&emci=a56f6e2a-8877-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=8d21dad0-2178-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=9329426) for other opportunities all across the country.
**3\. Share your support for Democrats on social media**
The Harris campaign is looking for supporters who are active on social media to help share Kamala's message. In addition to following of the campaign's social media channels (which everyone should do), you can sign up **[here](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93277529/499948103/-395716114?refcode=jtk1379-fr-nd1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOGQyMWRhZDAtMjE3OC1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZWU2NjgxIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=TjFhv5eGdldb7d_xxwELcfIBSd5FR98YojbXyWhZQzk=&emci=a56f6e2a-8877-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&emdi=8d21dad0-2178-ef11-991a-6045bdee6681&ceid=9329426)** to attend a special virtual training on how to maximize the impact of your own social media accounts.
**4\. Make a donation to the Harris-Walz campaign.**

You may already know who I am from my basketball career. Or, maybe you're just hearing about me for the first time through my Senate Campaign. Either way, I wanted to formally introduce myself and share my story. [**_Afterward, I 'm going to ask you to send a small contribution to my campaign as I continue to fight to Flip the Senate Red._**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=b11bd8883d654d07ade6712f2bc9185b&_e=9tgbhz-0ER8o33L_VUwFUESrPqVdLhd9a5y-RvIqV8JqObgi9TN-c9kpsl6Tr-to6ssw-ynRA69KYjPdROWUUpZTRwViw_jfkU6Ul7fYy4S7wl0eEg5KKx0EL715kkWopK0XbzIsoHrwJibEKQuVvks3TIekY4VvjWUgQH9yl36JGET-NMXw5fhH9CD0m-A38v0k1RVVTaZSKGVRv1n0WTiVEo7bQVLpmM6a4PYF3fyzAodV-_SZCs283y6RXlgap_JGGS7SkyPqjjMCaec6q5auFy7gHgit-oqKlimdIsbPRxygxTknHDOJYeDAGOUAK75An0dool8je7EQKj3dTA%3D%3D)

I was born and raised in the Twin Cities in Minnesota, mainly in the Rondo Community of St. Paul. At the age of five, I started playing sports, and at nine years old, I was already playing basketball on the Northside of Minneapolis. My mother was a single mother who worked tirelessly to give me a better life. I went to school in Rondo and began to excel at basketball. By 10th grade, I was ranked as a top 20 player in the country. I remember dreaming of reaching the NBA one day- a dream shared by millions of kids.

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=b11bd8883d654d07ade6712f2bc9185b&_e=9tgbhz-0ER8o33L_VUwFUESrPqVdLhd9a5y-RvIqV8JqObgi9TN-c9kpsl6Tr-to6ssw-ynRA69KYjPdROWUUpZTRwViw_jfkU6Ul7fYy4S7wl0eEg5KKx0EL715kkWopK0XbzIsoHrwJibEKQuVvks3TIekY4VvjWUgQH9yl36JGET-NMXw5fhH9CD0m-A3Sg7TYub3M5A7nKXBqqhCYX2RXh8_YXT-BSRsINIPwgww-LeQVyGD-ZKXpxxSInkJktE21_ao5V0CSBBtTE9wZn_J1pGXqVt5ViJbwdIZJfopfEFrD8Nr3GnB_-3cs7Z6DX5FAKBBv4qblvoBAbwEnw%3D%3D)
I accepted a scholarship at the University of Minnesota, but shortly after transferred to Iowa State. There, I won multiple basketball awards while working hard in class and being named on the Dean's List for academics.

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=b11bd8883d654d07ade6712f2bc9185b&_e=9tgbhz-0ER8o33L_VUwFUESrPqVdLhd9a5y-RvIqV8JqObgi9TN-c9kpsl6Tr-to6ssw-ynRA69KYjPdROWUUpZTRwViw_jfkU6Ul7fYy4S7wl0eEg5KKx0EL715kkWopK0XbzIsoHrwJibEKQuVvks3TIekY4VvjWUgQH9yl36JGET-NMXw5fhH9CD0m-A34J5MLQxOdW8a9UZk5W7paiG2s1dT6_HbsLEbEE3Rqx8Gl71FCYJ1t9fnc_3n2nVLY68d_CJXm9CBYGtyP_b170uxVlLOZVf96r0XZUfbBJGBUBHZdUD-Tx4IxlAA58uWijoeFHA6-N3DcwQR2tELpQ%3D%3D)
Finally, my dream came true. I was selected in the first round of the 2012 NBA Draft, going to the Houston Rockets. While playing at the highest level of basketball competition in the world, I began to voice concerns about the NBA's Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), specifically regarding mental health policy, which at the time did not exist.

Eventually, my concerns became a dispute between the NBA and myself, until I demanded that the NBA spearhead the mental health conversation through policy. This led to the end of my NBA career, but my work led to the NBA implementing policies to support players' mental health.

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=b11bd8883d654d07ade6712f2bc9185b&_e=9tgbhz-0ER8o33L_VUwFUESrPqVdLhd9a5y-RvIqV8JqObgi9TN-c9kpsl6Tr-to6ssw-ynRA69KYjPdROWUUpZTRwViw_jfkU6Ul7fYy4S7wl0eEg5KKx0EL715kkWopK0XbzIsoHrwJibEKQuVvks3TIekY4VvjWUgQH9yl36JGET-NMXw5fhH9CD0m-A39FcY24qkVUtlyTwLaomO84bshlepJHE0aVcKW35-RaBG6WNvheMN5sz4HJyjfJJQHDt4J4Yv0I1XjwvV3Jn9N6N0GS27gyGWzd9BdUQccWgk8tW3O5O6WCez2yIAKAk13jcI9wQcY3FhDIPJRXH2ig%3D%3D)
I gave up my dream of playing in the NBA to stand up for something I fully believe in. That experience gave me the courage to run for Congress in 2022 and for Senate in 2024. More on that later.

After leaving the NBA, I took my talents to Canada, playing professional basketball and winning two championships. Then, I joined the BIG 3 Basketball Tournament, a professional 3 on 3 league; I still play today.

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=b11bd8883d654d07ade6712f2bc9185b&_e=9tgbhz-0ER8o33L_VUwFUESrPqVdLhd9a5y-RvIqV8JqObgi9TN-c9kpsl6Tr-to6ssw-ynRA69KYjPdROWUUpZTRwViw_jfkU6Ul7fYy4S7wl0eEg5KKx0EL715kkWopK0XbzIsoHrwJibEKQuVvks3TIekY4VvjWUgQH9yl36JGET-NMXw5fhH9CD0m-A3bD7bQnCxlHCBhlTtrr8FN7hBpeYPsakNtXJDBWXOvT0odZrEOJG6pNzERDl6ymstE18HETeInSPdhwrB3FNnpYToqsX7csElcQsDJzqoWxtfw0eMvfftP16VQQYS1N5gpdKqn27w4L0kmga4XU1CNA%3D%3D)
It was at this point that I became increasingly vocal about standing up for the core principles that I believe in. I've continued to be outspoken on taboo subjects, like freeing the Uyghurs, the Federal Reserve, Julian Assange, Edward Snowden, Muammar Gaddafi, and many others. **I 'm not afraid to speak up and say the silent part out loud. I will never just shut up and dribble.**

In 2022, I decided to run for Congress against Radical Leftist and Squad Founder, Ilhan Omar. The Deep State Democrats lined her pocket with millions of dollars to beat me, and I came up short.

[](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=b11bd8883d654d07ade6712f2bc9185b&_e=9tgbhz-0ER8o33L_VUwFUESrPqVdLhd9a5y-RvIqV8JqObgi9TN-c9kpsl6Tr-to6ssw-ynRA69KYjPdROWUUpZTRwViw_jfkU6Ul7fYy4S7wl0eEg5KKx0EL715kkWopK0XbzIsoHrwJibEKQuVvks3TIekY4VvjWUgQH9yl36JGET-NMXw5fhH9CD0m-A3fXBcije1daElKzTS1wAnK81mb6ZV8-nbi8gpo9nX3cAJ2tpH4zWrD92nzwIEVDvoS12gR4m_f75pqExjZCXyIXQPP0vnbAZHhvOQnDWZjPvxlZKXWqf5YKezUzJC55n9eFUgKFYVwPdTgOdEOZqP1g%3D%3D)
Now, I'm running for United States Senate to defeat lifelong politician Amy Klobuchar. She represents the Radical Left's Elites who would rather see America become the next Communist China or Soviet Russia. The Industrial Media Complex will continue to spread false narratives claiming that I have little chance of winning. But they continue to ignore my strong grassroots movement with the American People, who are sick and tired of being overstepped, ignored, and told to accept the policies that our Liberal Leaders force down our throats.

We CAN win, but it's going to take the help of a huge grassroots movement. That's why I'm emailing you today, friend. We have a chance to make history by electing the youngest US Senator and the first one born in the 1990s.

[**I am humbly asking you to send my campaign a small donation of whatever you can afford. Whether it 's $5, $15, or $25, every single donation makes a difference.**](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=ce1ce9e616484205a28a45cfaf96cecf&_m=b11bd8883d654d07ade6712f2bc9185b&_e=9tgbhz-0ER8o33L_VUwFUESrPqVdLhd9a5y-RvIqV8JqObgi9TN-c9kpsl6Tr-to6ssw-ynRA69KYjPdROWUUpZTRwViw_jfkU6Ul7fYy4S7wl0eEg5KKx0EL715kkWopK0XbzIsoHrwJibEKQuVvks3TIekY4VvjWUgQH9yl36JGET-NMXw5fhH9CD0m-A3luaXlQMCrt-lnRKMbGOAQOOBevoTGPFht8ZqbwLQ26LFdfJkP5nGQvQdJ8PCZgw0eO_YwYO4vtCqQEjNRyHCPnhFpnVCwIrKiC3-nXNFvxfbeb9HN5SqqzWJlW7opf0QKnts12JSzI24V-pvSSI7cQ%3D%3D)

I'm looking forward to getting to know you better, and I hope you'll join my team.

Talk Soon,

Royce White

| PAID FOR BY ROYCE WHITE FOR SENATE
P.O. Box 5473 Hopkins, MN 55343

body:
Once Joe Biden dropped out, the surge of enthusiasm for Democrat candidates nationwide reached new levels; enthusiasm levels we haven’t seen since Barack Obama |
---
[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=80eacfec1f02487e95b06a651b861991&_e=imuuH6mzFqr7nay3r3Hc64X5T36SMzva2BBnFfJkeUfDNarkZtr-xwnXwDifFHHdsjMQTIXvt2bemYWOK9z8671AGcPv2qna8WLjXLFkpzf8THJKWqhzCB7sJ4qvS84KBzbPIkVvHYKmBCBkf0ZCFPUksQJ9iwrFrn_Cyb0U1zMkVvgydTkbgJ9PMyI3za91PDYRzc9hP8EadmknIRAo8C338HVhUtFFw-XPE4yjy1HLwJeev5dy4OTgJFBbtOdoRES9DtgQsiXZ3llWsRtRmAHp_yJbR7s1al3XWUyywkhpw7yHtHYSWqUBxNiU050yjgf_ZrIpKUjKbeULVkMVBkx3wssTRA0PTTQwSUzkDYffTQUcws0mEHBwEAzgYVad9EXmtgp1vs5tposLKwKsHJt2qRGCdyUNqmbtWFTXMVc%3D)

Fellow American,

Panic is setting in. **With just 46 days until Election Day and just 18 days until ballots are mailed to voters across Montana,** we’re worried that the lack of cash on hand might cause us to lose this critical battleground Senate race.

I’m pleading with you to **[chip in now so we don’t lose this race](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=80eacfec1f02487e95b06a651b861991&_e=imuuH6mzFqr7nay3r3Hc64X5T36SMzva2BBnFfJkeUfDNarkZtr-xwnXwDifFHHdsjMQTIXvt2bemYWOK9z8671AGcPv2qna8WLjXLFkpzf8THJKWqhzCB7sJ4qvS84KBzbPIkVvHYKmBCBkf0ZCFPUksQJ9iwrFrn_Cyb0U1zMkVvgydTkbgJ9PMyI3za91PDYRzc9hP8EadmknIRAo8C338HVhUtFFw-XPE4yjy1HLwJeev5dy4OTgJFBbtOdoRES9DtgQsiXZ3llWsRtRmHpZb9NqTP8uN3TnFYcRCjP4DSth3LW0MNKb3RnlNQP2DmZfGEcerVZe5d9_Zdp6Xp8XqCBpuXEkaD-3WkDZjlPqP3C-CCVGnYmzJK352jxyKb-HqwkQbGglphpglKxmEIRLpreWcc4sSatYhNG4Pyc%3D)** —Republicans’ best shot at flipping the Senate in years.

[**CHIP IN THE MAXIMUM AMOUNT YOU CAN**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=80eacfec1f02487e95b06a651b861991&_e=imuuH6mzFqr7nay3r3Hc64X5T36SMzva2BBnFfJkeUfDNarkZtr-xwnXwDifFHHdsjMQTIXvt2bemYWOK9z8671AGcPv2qna8WLjXLFkpzf8THJKWqhzCB7sJ4qvS84KBzbPIkVvHYKmBCBkf0ZCFPUksQJ9iwrFrn_Cyb0U1zMkVvgydTkbgJ9PMyI3za91PDYRzc9hP8EadmknIRAo8C338HVhUtFFw-XPE4yjy1HLwJeev5dy4OTgJFBbtOdoRES9DtgQsiXZ3llWsRtRmBrO3W4r69Pnmydbv76T_e8h5V_j13Dzfm7yhh9Um4dc8jJ6XrqQuPQNPH1wL_RMAx2MTzuJIfV8Xq4a_GEfUPOpDlEo6v_uo5pEswma_-ObzoM81jqCn8QaYGIhRnyZsMbCMFlu50t4qXo9nWYJcIo%3D)
**This is no joke.** The time is nigh to get involved - to donate, to volunteer, to help **[spread the word to your friends and family that if they don’t want Democrats to trash everything we’ve worked so hard to build during the Trump years, then they must act swiftly](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=80eacfec1f02487e95b06a651b861991&_e=imuuH6mzFqr7nay3r3Hc64X5T36SMzva2BBnFfJkeUfDNarkZtr-xwnXwDifFHHdsjMQTIXvt2bemYWOK9z8671AGcPv2qna8WLjXLFkpzf8THJKWqhzCB7sJ4qvS84KBzbPIkVvHYKmBCBkf0ZCFPUksQJ9iwrFrn_Cyb0U1zMkVvgydTkbgJ9PMyI3za91PDYRzc9hP8EadmknIRAo8C338HVhUtFFw-XPE4yjy1HLwJeev5dy4OTgJFBbtOdoRES9DtgQsiXZ3llWsRtRmHkvR4KR9VdcTcytypzJ_xEzg0LhJwB6c9Mbk4lSL8DN6UMSRazD0yh0kHdH-Bjlj6FfMRlorkxxACGNJuZc1pSzcMhHdPvy51Jq-MDfaDeRCy2wkOA0KK2s_8CvgkluZhPeVu5kV00DhE964NB6oMU%3D)**.

While our polling numbers might look solid now, the fact remains that Jon Tester can raise an unlimited amount of money from his army of grassroots donors. _**And if somehow that wasn’t enough to buy all of the ads on Montana television from now through Election Day, Kamala Harris is raising so much money she’s beginning to transfer millions to down-ballot races like mine.**_

Tom is the proud husband to Rhonda and the proud father to two beautiful daughters. Their family resides in the wonderful city of Westfield, New Jersey. Experts report that I’m the most vulnerable woman in the Senate, so the GOP and their outside groups are spending tens of millions of dollars to unseat me. Growing up in a small town like Butte, Nebraska, you learn to take care of each other.
The family down the road may not think, pray, or love like you, but they are your neighbors and you look out for them.

My friend Tina Smith understands this. And she works hard every day to ensure Minnesotans’ voices are heard in the United States Senate.
